object.name: evi.dcblock~
object.description: A basic dc blocking filter utility for cleaning your audio signals.

inlets.description: For an ordinary dc blocking filter this should be left at the default (0.9997). But varying this will change to strength of the dc blocker. Towards 0.99 you will start to hear the filter as it's highpass becomes stronger. At 1 the filter is effectively bypassed.

arguments.name: coefficient
arguments.description: a0 coefficient to set the filter amount
